name: Guatemala

flag.description: Three equal vertical bands of sky blue, white and sky blue, with the coat of arms in the centre: a resplendent quetzal perched on a scroll dated 15 September 1821, over crossed rifles and swords inside a laurel wreath.
flag.symbolism: The blue bands represent the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea, and white represents peace and purity; the quetzal symbolises liberty.

hook: Guatemala turns the Central American blue-white-blue sideways into vertical bands, with a green quetzal bird perched on crossed rifles.
trivia: The date on the scroll, 15 September 1821, is the day Central America declared independence from Spain.
Guatemala's currency, the quetzal, is named after the same bird that appears on its flag.
